0022600230.text: The Suns (4-6) host the Hornets (4-7) in their 11th game of the season, with Phoenix at home 4-3 and on the road 0-3, currently on a one-game win streak and sitting 11th in the West. Mark Williams is out for Phoenix after shoulder surgery, while Charlotte is missing Dennis Schroder, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel, all out with hamstring issues, and Brandon Miller and Moussa Diabate are day-to-day with groin soreness and a quadriceps injury, respectively, and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season and split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with the most recent meeting on April 2, 2026, in Charlotte, where the Suns lost 127-107.
